video_caption: The video opens with a beautiful, slowly rotating spiral galaxy, its bright white core and intricate purplish-grey arms adorned with countless stars, set against a dark, star-studded cosmic background. This transitions to a graphic on a white background, presenting a bar chart titled "THE UNIVERSE" at the top. A vertical segment labeled "MATTER" (English: Matter) with a galaxy image inside, shows an orange section representing "5%", next to a blue section labeled "DARK MATTER" (English: Dark Matter) representing "25%" with a starry, cloudy texture. The largest segment, in purple, is labeled "DARK ENERGY" (English: Dark Energy) and represents "70%", featuring a blurry purple cloudy texture. The scene then shifts to a simulation of the universe's large-scale structure, a dark expanse filled with countless bright dots forming a web-like network, depicting galaxies and cosmic filaments in motion. Next, a woman with long, dark, curly hair, wearing a white top and a turquoise necklace, appears in a purple and blue framed video call, speaking to the camera from a room with green plants. Text below her identifies her as "ALEXANDRA AMON / Scientist, Dark Energy Survey". The cosmic simulation returns, showing stars and nebulae, first sparsely then more densely, eventually resolving into a dynamic, swirling spiral galaxy with a bright yellow core and blue-white arms. The video concludes with a stunning close-up, horizontal view of a galaxy's disc, revealing a luminous central bulge and dark, intricate lanes of dust and gas, dotted with stars.

The video opens with a man, sporting dark curly hair and a beard, wearing a light blue checkered shirt, speaking directly to the camera against a plain off-white wall. The scene then transitions to a captivating close-up of a dense star cluster or galaxy, teeming with countless white, blue, and red stars against a deep black cosmic backdrop. This view is then replaced by a grid of numerous small rectangular panels, each displaying a different section of a star-filled night sky with bright stars and distant galaxies, one panel highlighted with a small red triangular marker and line pointing to an object. Finally, the scene changes to a striking wide shot of a dark, starry night sky over a silhouette of multiple observatory domes and buildings atop a hill, showing a gradient sky from blue-green to black. A red, open hexagonal graphic with an inset starry field appears on the left, alongside the white text "THE DARK ENERGY SURVEY", while a faint red light trail sweeps across the bottom of the screen.

The video opens with a woman, Giulia Giannini, identified as a Scientist for the Dark Energy Survey, speaking to the camera from a room with green plants. She wears a dark red cardigan and earphones. The scene then transitions to a nighttime view of two observatory domes under a starry sky with the Milky Way. Following this, a breathtaking shot of a spiral galaxy appears. A man with curly dark hair and a beard, wearing a light blue checkered shirt, then speaks to the camera against a plain white background. The video returns to an outdoor shot, showing multiple white observatory domes perched on a brown, rocky mountain under a clear blue sky during the day. This is followed by an interior view of a large telescope, showcasing its intricate machinery and lenses. The observatory domes are again seen silhouetted against a vibrant night sky, with red lights at their bases. Text overlays, "DARK ENERGY SURVEY YEAR 3," introduce animated graphics illustrating the survey's scope: "345 nights observed," "5000 deg² of night sky," and "226 million galaxies." A person in a blue cleanroom suit and hairnet is then shown peering into a large, glowing circular lens, part of a scientific instrument. The initial speaker reappears, talking from the same plant-filled room. Finally, the video displays a large, complex scientific instrument, predominantly blue, white, and yellow, within a vast industrial facility, with two men standing nearby and orange safety cones on the floor. The segment concludes with a serene shot of layered, hazy blue mountain ranges under a soft, diffused light.

The video opens with an aerial shot of an observatory complex featuring several white dome-shaped telescope buildings situated on a rugged hilltop at sunrise or sunset, with misty mountains and valleys stretching into the distance. This transitions to a stunning night view of the same observatory, showcasing three prominent white telescope domes under a dark sky densely packed with stars, including the Milky Way galaxy and the Magellanic Clouds, with a faint greenish airglow visible in parts of the sky. A woman with dark hair, wearing a red cardigan and white earphones, then appears on screen, speaking directly to the camera against a gradient background of purple and blue with two green plants. The scene returns to the night observatory before transitioning to a black screen filled with countless small white dots, which represent galaxies, clustered together in various patterns. The text "GALAXY CLUSTERING" is displayed in light, slightly purple letters at the bottom of the screen, explaining the visual representation of clustered galaxies.

The video begins with a dark, starry field representing numerous galaxies, with the text "GALAXY CLUSTERING" appearing in white at the bottom. This transitions to a low-angle shot of two white observatory domes under a clear night sky, showcasing countless stars and the luminous band of the Milky Way galaxy. The larger dome on the left has small lights illuminating its base. The scene then shifts to an animation of a purple and white spiral galaxy with a bright central core against a dark cosmic background. This image is then duplicated, creating a split screen with two identical views of the galaxy. Below these images, the text "WEAK GRAVITATIONAL LENSING" is displayed in white.

The video opens with a man who has dark curly hair and a beard, wearing a light blue collared shirt. He holds up an empty, clear wine glass in his right hand. He then brings the base of the wine glass close to the camera, causing the image of his face and the background to appear distorted through the glass. As he slowly moves the glass away from the camera, the amount of distortion changes. The scene then transitions to a vibrant, starry night sky filled with colorful nebulae in shades of red, orange, and teal. This cosmic scene fades into a close-up of an abstract painting with thick, textured brushstrokes in various shades of blue and teal, giving the impression of swirling waves or clouds. The camera slowly zooms in on the painting.

The video opens with a static shot of a blue and green Earth on the left against a starry dark blue background, facing a swirling, bright blue and white spiral galaxy on the right. A woman with long, dark, curly hair and a white top with a turquoise necklace then appears in a video call frame, speaking directly to the camera, occasionally gesturing with her hands, and smiling in front of a white wall adorned with several green potted plants. This transitions to a man with dark, curly hair and a beard, wearing a light blue checkered shirt, also speaking directly to the camera from a plain white room. The scene returns to the space shot, where the word "REDSHIFT" in white text appears at the bottom center of the screen. Initially, the spiral galaxy is blue and white, but as the man explains, a blue arrow points from the galaxy towards Earth, and the galaxy turns a more vibrant blue, indicating movement towards the observer. Subsequently, the blue arrow disappears, and a red arrow then points away from Earth, causing the galaxy to shift from blue to a bright red, illustrating redshift as the galaxy moves away.

The video segment opens with a woman with dark, curly hair and a white top speaking to the camera, positioned in front of several potted plants. This transitions to an animation of a large, tilted barred spiral galaxy with a bright core and prominent arms filled with stars and nebulae. Following this, an edge-on view of another spiral galaxy with a yellow-orange core and a flatter, dusty disc is shown. The scene then shifts to a different woman with brown hair, wearing a red cardigan and white earphones, speaking directly to the camera, with potted plants visible behind her. The segment concludes with a final animation of a spiral galaxy viewed face-on, featuring a bright central core and distinct, rotating spiral arms in shades of white, grey, and light blue.

The video opens with a majestic view of a spiral galaxy, its bright core emitting light and its arms swirling outwards against a dark, star-filled background. The image then transitions to a more detailed and colorful depiction of what appears to be the Whirlpool Galaxy (M51), showing intricate spiral arms with vibrant pink and blue star-forming regions, and a smaller, interacting galaxy visible to its upper right. This is followed by a shot of a woman, Alexandra Amon, a scientist from the Dark Energy Survey, visible from the chest up. She has dark, curly hair, a bright smile, and is wearing a white sleeveless top and earbuds, speaking directly to the camera. The text "ALEXANDRA AMON, Scientist, Dark Energy Survey" is displayed below her. The scene then shifts to a field of countless galaxies and stars against a black backdrop, with some galaxies appearing stretched and curved due to gravitational lensing. Finally, the video concludes with an animated representation of the universe's expansion, starting with a bright burst on the left representing the Big Bang, leading to a grid-like space-time continuum expanding to the right, illustrating galaxies spreading further apart over cosmic time. Text at the bottom left reads "Video Credit: NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center," attributing the animation to NASA.

The video begins with an animated visualization of the universe's expansion, showing a timeline from a dense, bright "EARLY UNIVERSE" (labeled in purple text at the bottom left) on the left to a less dense, star-filled "LATE UNIVERSE" (labeled in purple text at the bottom right) on the right, all within a gridded, tube-like structure representing space-time. The bottom left of the screen also displays "Video Credit: NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center" in white text. This transitions to a view of a spiral galaxy amidst countless stars and other smaller galaxies in deep space. Next, a woman with long, dark, curly hair tied back is shown from the chest up, wearing a white sleeveless top and wired earbuds, speaking and gesturing with her hands. She is positioned against a light beige, textured wall, with a gradient blue-to-purple border framing the video feed on both sides. The video then cuts to a vibrant, colorful image of a nebula, featuring swirling blues, purples, greens, and pinks, interspersed with bright stars.

The video begins with a vibrant, colorful image of a nebula, showcasing swirling gas and dust in shades of green, purple, and yellow with scattered stars. This transitions to a heat map-like visualization of the cosmic microwave background, displaying blue and orange speckles against a light background, indicating variations in density or temperature in the early universe. Next, a dark, intricate simulation or image of the cosmic web appears, featuring bright yellow-orange clusters of light interconnected by a dark, filamentary network. This is followed by a white screen showing a scientific graph titled "DARK ENERGY SURVEY Y3 RESULTS," with the Y-axis labeled "S8 (CLUMPINESS OF MATTER)" and the X-axis "Ωm (DENSITY OF MATTER)." Two overlapping shaded ellipses are present on the graph: a red one, labeled "EARLY UNIVERSE" (CMB measurements by the Planck satellite), and a grey one, labeled "LATE UNIVERSE" (DES Y3 weak lensing and clustering). The red ellipse is positioned slightly higher and to the right of the grey ellipse. The video concludes with an older man with grey hair, wearing a blue and grey jacket over a light blue shirt, standing in what appears to be an observatory control room. He gazes upward and to his right with a thoughtful expression, his left hand resting on a grey control panel filled with buttons and dials.

The video begins with a woman in a white sleeveless top, with long curly dark hair, smiling and speaking directly to the camera, wearing green earphones, against a plain light wall background. This transitions to an animated graphic overlay on a time-lapse star trail background with observatory domes, displaying "DARK ENERGY SURVEY COLLABORATION" and icons representing "400+ scientists," "25 institutions," "7 countries," and "300+ papers." Next, two individuals, a woman with long brown hair and glasses, and a man with grey hair and glasses, are shown in an office setting, both looking at computer screens, with multiple monitors visible behind them. This is followed by three men, one with long grey hair and a green shirt, another with dark hair and a brown sweater, and a third with short white hair and a white sweater, working on equipment in what appears to be a laboratory or workshop. Then, two men are seen sitting at computers in a control room, one wearing a red jacket and the other a blue jacket, focusing on their screens. A breathtaking view of the Milky Way galaxy in a dark night sky is then shown, panning slowly across the stars. The video returns to the star trail and observatory background, displaying text: "FOR MORE INFORMATION, VISIT WWW.DARKENERGYSURVEY.ORG", which is then joined by "WWW.FNAL.GOV" and image credits. The final scene features a grey-scale panoramic view of the Fermilab Wilson Hall reflected in a lake, as a blue logo and the word "Fermilab" appear, followed by "U.S. DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY" and "Office of Science."
